item.text: {"iteration":5,"pcvs":[{"name":"prompt_headroom","expression":"max(0, self.vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len - len(request.prompt_token_ids)) if request.prompt_token_ids is not None else 0","rationale":"Tests a decreasing length basis, allowing fitted cost components to be larger for shorter prompts."},{"name":"nine_token_prompt","expression":"int(request.prompt_token_ids is not None and len(request.prompt_token_ids) == 9)","rationale":"Separates the elevated nine-token state."},{"name":"ten_token_prompt","expression":"int(request.prompt_token_ids is not None and len(request.prompt_token_ids) == 10)","rationale":"Separates the highest-cost observed state."},{"name":"medium_prompt","expression":"int(request.prompt_token_ids is not None and 12 <= len(request.prompt_token_ids) < 23)","rationale":"Restores the flat medium-prompt indicator from the best-performing candidate."}],"hypothesis":"The flat medium-prompt indicator performed better than its ramp replacement.
